purpose: Render and QA two silent full-resolution chapter smokes before producing the first five narrated videos.

required_qa: frame count, dimensions, frame rate, duration, codec, and audio absence
opening, middle, and final decoded frames

resource.actual_shape_policy: After creation, verify the owned pod identity, exact GPU, Secure Cloud, image digest, compute rate at or below the cap, at least 4 vCPUs and 8 GB RAM, no persistent volume, and only SSH. Delete immediately on mismatch.

quote.cpu_catalog_observation: All six documented 4-vCPU CPU flavors reported NONE at quote time; their current rates ranged from $0.12 to $0.26 per hour. No CPU Pod is authorized by this proposal.

authorization_ceiling.retry_policy: A second create is permitted only after the first owned pod is terminal or unavailable and its absence is reconciled. Never run two pods concurrently.

transport_and_cleanup.credential_reference: existing RUNPOD_API_KEY environment variable; never print, copy, persist, bundle, or transmit its value except as the RunPod API authorization header
transport_and_cleanup.upload: SFTP the one hash-bound bundle to the one owned ephemeral pod and verify SHA-256 before extraction
transport_and_cleanup.download: Download only the bounded result archive; verify paths, hashes, media contracts, and QA records locally

authorization_effect: Approval authorizes only the exact two-job smoke described here. It does not authorize the remaining chapters, narration, the five complete videos, the 51-video series, publication, commit, or push.
